descriptionPlain: Example EU Co builds compliance tooling for European fintechs. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the frontend of our review console: dense data tables, audit trails, and a workflow engine that has to be legible under pressure. TypeScript and React, with a Python service behind it. EU residency or an EU-registered contracting entity is required for this role because of the data we handle. Remote across the European Union.
Run the deployment platform: Kubernetes, Terraform, and the developer tooling around them. Mostly Go and Python. Remote across the European Union, EU work permit required.
